item.tib: shes rab smra seng sgrub gzhung ma rig mun sel
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di ni bdag 'dra gnam bon shes rab dgongs rgyal la/ sa skyong shing bya'i 'brug zla'i bco lnga la/ lha mchog smra seng dang dngos mjal zhal lung gnang yang yi ger ma bkod kyang / de nas rnam 'gyur lcags stag lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la/ rab 'byams blo gros 'od zer gyis bskul ngor yi ger bkod pa/ lo mang song ba'i cung tsam ma rtogs brjed 'dug pa'i lhag chad nor 'khrul nyes 'gal gang byung rnams/ mkhyen ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ dge rtsa gang byung 'gro kun don du bsngo//
